FIRST AMENDMENT TO OFFICE LEASE

Effective as of January 15, 2030, Landlord and Tenant amend the Lease as follows:

1. EXTENSION. The Term is extended so that it shall expire on February 28, 2036.

2. EXTENSION RENT. Commencing March 1, 2031, Base Rent shall be $44.00 per rentable square foot per year through February 28, 2036.

3. EXPANSION. Effective March 1, 2031, the Premises shall contain 15,000 rentable square feet.
